title: Surrender of Tranquebar (1808)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Surrender of Tranquebar (1808)", at revision 1370749063, opens: "The Surrender of Tranquebar or the Capture of Tranquebar was a surrender of the capital of Danish India, Tranquebar, in 1808 to the British East India Company as a result of the English Wars. The capital surrendered almost immediately after the arrival of a British force." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q127163443, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1808 capture of a European fort in India". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
